scientific.integrity: The local Adan recurrence is reduced exactly to a cubic characteristic polynomial; exact cubic Schur conditions identify the active boundary, and the squared adaptive state supplies a separate stable first-order mode.
limitations: Local deterministic analysis with no weight decay, clipping, restart, or stochastic noise.
Bias-corrected implementation is handled through its limiting Jacobian.
Nonlinear dynamics beyond the local instability are not classified.

title: Exact default-parameter local stability ceiling for Adan
